newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates end shade down at 21.25/21.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates end shade down at 21.25/21.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank rates closed slightly lower on Monday in a liquid market, traders said.
Rates began between 21.5 and 21.625 percent then, rose slightly before falling back to 21.25 to 21.5 percent, near Friday's close of 21.5 percent, they said.

"There's nothing special on the market at the moment, it's very liquid," said Jozsef Laczi, of ING Bank, adding that rates could rise on Wednesday when mobile phone company Pannon GSM issues bonds worth a total 24 billion forints ($138.1 million).
